title: Stitch Skills
summary: 8 Google Stitch MCP skills covering: stitch-design (primary entry point for screen generation/editing), taste-design (premium anti-generic DESIGN.md generation), design-md (synthesizing DESIGN.md from existing projects), enhance-prompt (transforming vague UI ideas into Stitch-optimized prompts), stitch-loop (autonomous iterative multi-page website building via baton-passing), react-components (converting Stitch designs to Vite/React components), shadcn-ui (shadcn/ui component integration), and remotion (walkthrough video generation from Stitch screens). Requires the stitch MCP server (https://stitch.googleapis.com/mcp).
